speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: The healthcare professional may be further referred to the Police if a criminal offence is likely to have been committed and to the relevant Professional Board for further disciplinary action.

speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Disciplinary actions were taken in all these cases, including suspension and being struck off the appropriate professional register.
